title: Complaints
purpose: Staff procedure for a complaint: who hears it, who decides, how fast.
facts: Five counter steps; the complaint is written on the order and raised as a high-priority card for the shop manager (S8: the lead advisor raised the card, the senior took it).

Decision table: apology by the advisor; up to 10 % by the advisor; over 10 %, free redo outside warranty and refunds by slot 4 (Chattanooga) or slot 22 (Nashville); technician complaints to the foreman; advisor complaints to slot 4 or 22; company accounts always slot 4 the same day.
Reply by the person who can fix it within one working day; promised calls back kept the same day.
Account A5 is served at west, so the rule "a company account: always slot 4" was not followed there: its complaint call was taken by slot 22 and never returned (S1).

rows.What the customer needs: An apology, an explanation of the bill
Money off, up to 10 % of the bill
rows.Who: The advisor, with the reason on the order

rows.What the customer needs: Money off over 10 %, a free redo outside warranty, a refund
rows.Who: Greg for Chattanooga, Dale for Nashville: Discount policy

rows.What the customer needs: A complaint about a technician's work
rows.Who: The foreman looks at the car. Nobody discusses the technician with the customer
Greg or Dale, not the advisor's colleague
Always Greg, the same day, whatever the size

list_items.section: At the counter or on the phone
list_items.item: Let them finish. Do not explain, do not defend the technician, do not say "no problem".

list_items.section: At the counter or on the phone
list_items.item: Say what you heard back to them in one sentence.

list_items.section: At the counter or on the phone
list_items.item: Say what happens next and when: "Greg will call you before noon tomorrow." Then make that true.

list_items.section: At the counter or on the phone
list_items.item: Write it on the order, in their words.

list_items.section: At the counter or on the phone
list_items.item: Raise a card on the board for the shop manager, high priority, with the order number. Do it before you take the next call.

new_facts: Company-account complaints go to slot 4 whatever the shop. Reason: makes the A5 failure a breach of a written rule rather than of good manners.
